# Tokyo Corner Diorama Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** An original, keyframe-animated Japanese street-corner diorama authored in Blender and shown in an example page that uses Margo's equivalent of every package the three.js `webgl_animation_keyframes` example uses.

**Architecture:** The diorama is generated by a committed bpy build script (`examples/assets/source/tokyo_diorama/`), run either live in the user's Blender through the Blender MCP (for viewing and iteration) or headless (`npm run build:tokyo`) to export a Draco-compressed GLB with one scene-wide clip. The example page loads it with gltf-pro + decoders, plays it with animation, lights it with a procedural studio cube through environment, and presents it with controls, stats and a colour background. Core and the stage facade are untouched.

**Tech Stack:** Blender 5.3 bpy/bmesh, glTF 2.0 exporter (Draco), TypeScript, Vite, Node `node:test`, Playwright via `scripts/browser.js`, WebGPU.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-tokyo-diorama-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Do not modify `@margoengine/core` or the stage facade (v1.0.0 freeze, AGENTS.md). No engine package changes; if one seems needed, stop and report.
- Everything in the scene is original: no geometry, signage text, characters or layouts copied or traced from Littlest Tokyo. Signs use abstract glyph-like strokes, never real text. The hero is a tanuki with a lantern — no panda, no maneki-neko.
- Budget: ≤150,000 triangles; `examples/assets/tokyo-diorama.glb` ≤5 MB (5,242,880 bytes).
- One looping clip named `Diorama`, 12 s long (24 fps, frames 1–289), object-level keyframes only (no armatures).
- Background colour `#bfe3dd`.
- Blender executable: `C:\Tools\Blender\5.3-Beta\blender-5.3.0-beta+v53.2ebd15112ac6-windows.amd64-release\blender.exe` (set `BLENDER` to override).
- Live Blender work goes through the Blender MCP (`mcp__Blender__execute_blender_code`); never wipe the user's own scenes — the build creates/reuses a scene named `Diorama`.

## Review Focus

- **Blender MCP re-runs:** running the build twice in the same Blender session must not duplicate objects or materials. Pinned by Task 1 step "re-run idempotence".
- **Reduced motion:** with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the clip is paused and auto-rotate is off on load. Pinned in Task 6's browser check.
- **Load failure:** a missing or corrupt GLB shows "Unable to load scene" and an alert, not a blank page. Pinned in Task 6's browser check (routes the GLB to a 404).
- **Clip loop seam:** first and last keyframes match so the tram, swings and spins loop without a jump. Pinned by kit helpers (`key` at both ends) and the asset test's duration check; visually confirmed in Task 4's MCP screenshot review.
- **Small/phone viewport:** controls and stats must not cover the diorama entirely at 390×844. Pinned in Task 6's browser check (layout assertion).

Coordinates (Blender, Z up, metres): slab 8 × 6 centred on the origin, top at z = 0. Street top z = 0.04, sidewalk top z = 0.14. Building fronts face −Y (toward the default camera). The tram runs along the front edge (y = −2.55) and turns up the left edge (x = −3.3).

// Structural checks on the Blender-exported Tokyo diorama (examples/assets/tokyo-diorama.glb).
// Rebuild the asset with `npm run build:tokyo` (needs Blender 5.3; see BLENDER in scripts/build-tokyo-diorama.mjs).
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFileSync, statSync} from 'node:fs';

const file = new URL('../examples/assets/tokyo-diorama.glb', import.meta.url);

function readGLB(path) {
  const bytes = readFileSync(path);
  assert.equal(bytes.toString('ascii', 0, 4), 'glTF', 'not a GLB');
  assert.equal(bytes.readUInt32LE(16), 0x4e4f534a, 'first chunk must be JSON');
  return JSON.parse(bytes.toString('utf8', 20, 20 + bytes.readUInt32LE(12)));
}

const doc = readGLB(file);
const nodeIndex = name => {
  const index = doc.nodes.findIndex(node => node.name === name);
  assert.ok(index >= 0, `missing node ${name}`);
  return index;
};
const channels = name => doc.animations[0].channels.filter(c => c.target.node === nodeIndex(name)).map(c => c.target.path);
const triangles = () => {
  let count = 0;
  for (const node of doc.nodes) if (node.mesh !== undefined) for (const p of doc.meshes[node.mesh].primitives)
    count += (p.indices !== undefined ? doc.accessors[p.indices].count : doc.accessors[p.attributes.POSITION].count) / 3;
  return count;
};

test('one 12 s Diorama clip, Draco-compressed', () => {
  assert.equal(doc.animations.length, 1);
  assert.equal(doc.animations[0].name, 'Diorama');
  const duration = Math.max(...doc.animations[0].samplers.map(s => doc.accessors[s.input].max[0]));
  assert.ok(duration > 11.9 && duration < 12.1, `clip lasts ${duration} s`);
  assert.ok(doc.extensionsRequired?.includes('KHR_draco_mesh_compression'), 'GLB is not Draco-compressed');
});

test('street, track and moving tram', () => {
  for (const name of ['Diorama_Root', 'Slab', 'Street', 'Sidewalk', 'Track_Rails', 'Track_Sleepers']) nodeIndex(name);
  assert.deepEqual(channels('Tram').sort(), ['rotation', 'translation']);
});

```python
"""Shared helpers for the Tokyo corner diorama (Blender 5.3, bpy + bmesh only)."""
import math
import random

import bmesh
import bpy
from mathutils import Euler, Matrix, Vector

FPS = 24
FRAME_START = 1
FRAME_END = 289  # 12 s loop: (289 - 1) / 24
SCENE = None


def srgb(hex_color):
    """'#rrggbb' -> linear RGB tuple."""
    h = hex_color.lstrip('#')
    c = [int(h[i:i + 2], 16) / 255 for i in (0, 2, 4)]
    return tuple(v / 12.92 if v <= 0.04045 else ((v + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4 for v in c)


def reset_scene():
    """Create or empty the 'Diorama' scene. Headless builds reuse the factory scene; the GUI keeps the user's scenes."""
    global SCENE
    if bpy.app.background:
        scene = bpy.context.scene
        scene.name = 'Diorama'
    else:
        scene = bpy.data.scenes.get('Diorama') or bpy.data.scenes.new('Diorama')
        window = bpy.context.window or bpy.context.window_manager.windows[0]
        window.scene = scene
    for ob in list(scene.collection.all_objects):
        bpy.data.objects.remove(ob, do_unlink=True)
    for collection in (bpy.data.meshes, bpy.data.curves, bpy.data.actions):
        for block in list(collection):
            if block.users == 0:
                collection.remove(block)
    scene.render.fps = FPS
    scene.frame_start = FRAME_START
    scene.frame_end = FRAME_END
    bpy.context.preferences.edit.keyframe_new_interpolation_type = 'LINEAR'
    SCENE = scene
    return scene


def material(name, color, roughness=0.75, metallic=0.0, emission=None, strength=0.0, double_sided=False):
    """Principled material 'TD_<name>', reused (and updated) across re-runs."""
    mat = bpy.data.materials.get('TD_' + name) or bpy.data.materials.new('TD_' + name)
    if mat.node_tree is None:
        mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    bsdf = next((n for n in nodes if n.type == 'BSDF_PRINCIPLED'), None)
    if bsdf is None:
        bsdf = nodes.new('ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled')
        output = next((n for n in nodes if n.type == 'OUTPUT_MATERIAL'), None) or nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')
        mat.node_tree.links.new(bsdf.outputs['BSDF'], output.inputs['Surface'])
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*srgb(color), 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    bsdf.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (*srgb(emission or '#000000'), 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = strength if emission else 0.0
    mat.use_backface_culling = not double_sided
    return mat


def _link(name, data, mat=None, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), scale=(1, 1, 1), parent=None):
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, data)
    SCENE.collection.objects.link(ob)
    if data is not None and mat is not None:
        data.materials.append(mat)
    ob.parent = parent
    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler = rot
    ob.scale = scale
    return ob


def _mesh(name, bm, smooth=False):
    if smooth:
        for face in bm.faces:
            face.smooth = True
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    return me


def empty(name, loc, parent=None):
    ob = _link(name, None, loc=loc, parent=parent)
    ob.empty_display_size = 0.2
    return ob


def box(name, size, loc, mat, parent=None, rot=(0, 0, 0), bevel=0.0):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=size, verts=bm.verts)
    if bevel:
        bmesh.ops.bevel(bm, geom=bm.edges[:], offset=bevel, segments=2, profile=0.5, affect='EDGES')
    return _link(name, _mesh(name, bm), mat, loc, rot, parent=parent)


def boxes(name, specs, mat, parent=None):
    """Many boxes in one mesh. specs: [(size, loc)] or [(size, loc, rot_euler)] in the object's local space."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    for spec in specs:
        size, loc = spec[0], spec[1]
        rot = Euler(spec[2] if len(spec) > 2 else (0, 0, 0))
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.LocRotScale(Vector(loc), rot, Vector(size)))
    return _link(name, _mesh(name, bm), mat, parent=parent)


def cylinder(name, radius, depth, loc, mat, parent=None, rot=(0, 0, 0), segments=16, radius_top=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=segments, radius1=radius,
                          radius2=radius if radius_top is None else radius_top, depth=depth)
    return _link(name, _mesh(name, bm, smooth=True), mat, loc, rot, parent=parent)


def sphere(name, radius, loc, mat, parent=None, scale=(1, 1, 1), segments=16, rings=8):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segments, v_segments=rings, radius=radius)
    return _link(name, _mesh(name, bm, smooth=True), mat, loc, scale=scale, parent=parent)


def ico(name, radius, loc, mat, parent=None, scale=(1, 1, 1)):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_icosphere(bm, subdivisions=1, radius=radius)
    return _link(name, _mesh(name, bm), mat, loc, scale=scale, parent=parent)


def prism(name, w, d, h, loc, mat, parent=None):
    """Gable roof: ridge along X, base w x d at z=0, apex at z=h."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    a = [bm.verts.new(v) for v in ((-w / 2, -d / 2, 0), (w / 2, -d / 2, 0), (w / 2, d / 2, 0), (-w / 2, d / 2, 0))]
    r = [bm.verts.new((-w / 2, 0, h)), bm.verts.new((w / 2, 0, h))]
    for face in ((a[0], a[1], r[1], r[0]), (a[2], a[3], r[0], r[1]), (a[0], r[0], a[3]), (a[1], a[2], r[1]), (a[0], a[3], a[2], a[1])):
        bm.faces.new(face)
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    return _link(name, _mesh(name, bm), mat, loc, parent=parent)


def rounded_slab(name, w, d, r, h, loc, mat, parent=None, seg=6):
    """Rounded-rectangle block, top face at the object origin, extruded h downward."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    outline = []
    for cx, cy, start in ((w / 2 - r, d / 2 - r, 0), (-w / 2 + r, d / 2 - r, 90), (-w / 2 + r, -d / 2 + r, 180), (w / 2 - r, -d / 2 + r, 270)):
        for k in range(seg + 1):
            angle = math.radians(start + 90 * k / seg)
            outline.append(bm.verts.new((cx + r * math.cos(angle), cy + r * math.sin(angle), 0)))
    top = bm.faces.new(outline)
    extruded = bmesh.ops.extrude_face_region(bm, geom=[top])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(0, 0, -h), verts=[e for e in extruded['geom'] if isinstance(e, bmesh.types.BMVert)])
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    return _link(name, _mesh(name, bm), mat, loc, parent=parent)


def tube(name, points, radius, mat, parent=None, sides=6):
    """Open tube along a polyline (wires, rails, pipes, wheel rims)."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    pts = [Vector(p) for p in points]
    rings = []
    for i, p in enumerate(pts):
        t = (pts[min(i + 1, len(pts) - 1)] - pts[max(i - 1, 0)]).normalized()
        u = t.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)) if abs(t.z) < 0.9 else Vector((1, 0, 0))).normalized()
        v = t.cross(u)
        rings.append([bm.verts.new(p + radius * (math.cos(k * math.tau / sides) * u + math.sin(k * math.tau / sides) * v)) for k in range(sides)])
    for r0, r1 in zip(rings, rings[1:]):
        for k in range(sides):
            bm.faces.new((r0[k], r0[(k + 1) % sides], r1[(k + 1) % sides], r1[k]))
    return _link(name, _mesh(name, bm, smooth=True), mat, parent=parent)


def sag(a, b, drop, n=16):
    """Points of a sagging wire from a to b (parabola, lowest point `drop` below the chord)."""
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    return [a.lerp(b, i / n) - Vector((0, 0, drop * 4 * (i / n) * (1 - i / n))) for i in range(n + 1)]


def ring(center, radius, axis, n=24):
    """Closed circle of points around `axis` ('X' or 'Y'), for wheel rims."""
    c = Vector(center)
    pts = []
    for k in range(n + 1):
        a = k * math.tau / n
        offset = Vector((0, math.cos(a), math.sin(a))) if axis == 'X' else Vector((math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a)))
        pts.append(c + radius * offset)
    return pts


def glyph_specs(width, height, seed, cells=3, depth=0.012):
    """Abstract brush-stroke marks for a sign face in the XZ plane (front at -Y). Not real text."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    specs = []
    cell = width / cells
    for c in range(cells):
        cx = -width / 2 + cell * (c + 0.5)
        for _ in range(3):
            if rng.random() < 0.5:
                specs.append(((cell * rng.uniform(0.35, 0.7), depth, height * 0.08), (cx + rng.uniform(-0.1, 0.1) * cell, 0, rng.uniform(-0.3, 0.3) * height)))
            else:
                specs.append(((cell * 0.08, depth, height * rng.uniform(0.35, 0.7)), (cx + rng.uniform(-0.25, 0.25) * cell, 0, rng.uniform(-0.15, 0.15) * height)))
    return specs


def key(ob, frame, **values):
    for path, value in values.items():
        setattr(ob, path, value)
        ob.keyframe_insert(data_path=path, frame=frame)


def spin(ob, axis, turns):
    """Continuous rotation about an Euler axis over the whole clip (exporter samples every frame)."""
    rot = list(ob.rotation_euler)
    rot[axis] = 0.0
    key(ob, FRAME_START, rotation_euler=rot)
    rot[axis] = math.tau * turns
    key(ob, FRAME_END, rotation_euler=rot)


def swing(ob, axis, amplitude_deg, cycles, phase=0.0, step=6):
    """Sine swing about an Euler axis; integer `cycles` keeps the loop seamless."""
    base = list(ob.rotation_euler)
    for frame in range(FRAME_START, FRAME_END + 1, step):
        t = (frame - FRAME_START) / (FRAME_END - FRAME_START)
        rot = list(base)
        rot[axis] = base[axis] + math.radians(amplitude_deg) * math.sin(math.tau * (cycles * t + phase))
        key(ob, frame, rotation_euler=rot)
```

```python
"""Slab, street, sidewalk, tram track and the tram that rolls along it."""
import math

from mathutils import Vector

import kit

RAIL_GAUGE = 0.28


def _line(a, b, step):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    n = max(1, int((b - a).length / step))
    return [a.lerp(b, i / n) for i in range(n)]


def path_points(step=0.1):
    """Front straight (y=-2.55), quarter arc around the front-left corner, left straight (x=-3.3)."""
    pts = _line((3.0, -2.55, 0), (-1.9, -2.55, 0), step)
    cx, cy, r = -1.9, -1.15, 1.4
    n = int(r * math.pi / 2 / step)
    pts += [Vector((cx + r * math.cos(math.radians(270 - 90 * i / n)), cy + r * math.sin(math.radians(270 - 90 * i / n)), 0)) for i in range(n)]
    pts += _line((-3.3, -1.15, 0), (-3.3, 1.9, 0), step) + [Vector((-3.3, 1.9, 0))]
    return pts


def path_sampler():
    pts = path_points()
    lengths = [0.0]
    for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
        lengths.append(lengths[-1] + (b - a).length)

    def at(s):
        s = min(max(s, 0.0), lengths[-1])
        i = next(j for j in range(len(lengths) - 1) if lengths[j + 1] >= s)
        a, b = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
        t = (s - lengths[i]) / max((b - a).length, 1e-9)
        d = (b - a).normalized()
        return a.lerp(b, t), math.atan2(d.y, d.x)

    return at, lengths[-1]


def _tram(root):
    green, cream = kit.material('tram_green', '#3f7a5e', 0.55), kit.material('tram_cream', '#efe3c4', 0.6)
    dark, glass = kit.material('tram_dark', '#26282c', 0.8), kit.material('tram_glass', '#9cc3cf', 0.15, emission='#fff1c9', strength=0.6)
    lamp = kit.material('tram_lamp', '#fff6d8', 0.3, emission='#fff1c2', strength=4.0)
    tram = kit.empty('Tram', (0, 0, 0.04), root)
    kit.box('Tram_Lower', (2.0, 0.8, 0.38), (0, 0, 0.36), green, tram, bevel=0.03)
    kit.box('Tram_Upper', (2.0, 0.8, 0.42), (0, 0, 0.76), cream, tram, bevel=0.03)
    kit.box('Tram_Roof', (1.9, 0.72, 0.1), (0, 0, 1.02), green, tram, bevel=0.04)
    kit.boxes('Tram_Windows', [((0.34, 0.82, 0.26), (x, 0, 0.78)) for x in (-0.66, -0.22, 0.22, 0.66)] + [((0.04, 0.6, 0.26), (sx * 1.0, 0, 0.78)) for sx in (-1, 1)], glass, tram)
    kit.boxes('Tram_Wheels', [((0.3, 0.06, 0.3), (x, y, 0.15)) for x in (-0.65, 0.65) for y in (-0.36, 0.36)], dark, tram)
    kit.boxes('Tram_Lamps', [((0.04, 0.12, 0.08), (sx * 1.01, 0, 0.45)) for sx in (-1, 1)], lamp, tram)
    kit.tube('Tram_Pantograph', [(0.2, 0, 1.07), (0, 0, 1.35), (-0.2, 0, 1.07)], 0.015, dark, tram)
    return tram


def build(root):
    kit.rounded_slab('Slab', 8.0, 6.0, 1.2, 0.5, (0, 0, 0), kit.material('slab', '#6b4f3a', 0.85), root)
    kit.rounded_slab('Street', 7.8, 5.8, 1.1, 0.04, (0, 0, 0.04), kit.material('asphalt', '#4a4b52', 0.9), root)
    kit.box('Sidewalk', (6.5, 4.75, 0.1), (0.55, 0.475, 0.09), kit.material('pavers', '#b9ad9b', 0.85), root)

    rail, sleeper = kit.material('rail', '#8e9196', 0.35, metallic=0.9), kit.material('sleeper', '#5a4636', 0.9)
    at, length = path_sampler()
    left, right, sleepers = [], [], []
    s = 0.0
    while s <= length:
        p, h = at(s)
        n = Vector((-math.sin(h), math.cos(h), 0))
        left.append(p + n * RAIL_GAUGE + Vector((0, 0, 0.07)))
        right.append(p - n * RAIL_GAUGE + Vector((0, 0, 0.07)))
        if round(s / 0.1) % 3 == 0:
            sleepers.append(((0.12, 0.8, 0.03), p + Vector((0, 0, 0.05)), (0, 0, h)))
        s += 0.1
    rails = kit.tube('Track_Rails', left, 0.02, rail, root)
    kit.tube('Track_Rail_R', right, 0.02, rail, rails)
    kit.boxes('Track_Sleepers', sleepers, sleeper, root)

    tram = _tram(root)
    for frame in range(kit.FRAME_START, kit.FRAME_END + 1, 6):
        t = (frame - kit.FRAME_START) / (kit.FRAME_END - kit.FRAME_START)
        p, h = at(length * (1 - math.cos(math.tau * t)) / 2)  # out and back, easing at both ends
        kit.key(tram, frame, location=(p.x, p.y, 0.04), rotation_euler=(0, 0, h))
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write `build.py`**

```python
"""Build the Tokyo corner diorama and optionally export it.

Headless:  blender --background --factory-startup --python build.py -- --out tokyo-diorama.glb [--blend tokyo-diorama.blend]
Live (Blender MCP):  runpy.run_path(r'<repo>/examples/assets/source/tokyo_diorama/build.py', run_name='tokyo_build')['main']()
"""
import importlib
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if HERE not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, HERE)

import bpy  # noqa: E402

import kit  # noqa: E402
import street  # noqa: E402

MODULES = [kit, street]
for module in MODULES:  # pick up edits when re-run inside a live Blender session
    importlib.reload(module)


def build():
    kit.reset_scene()
    root = kit.empty('Diorama_Root', (0, 0, 0))
    for module in MODULES[1:]:
        module.build(root)
    kit.SCENE.frame_set(kit.FRAME_START)
    return root


def export(path):
    window = bpy.context.window or (bpy.context.window_manager.windows[0] if bpy.context.window_manager.windows else None)
    override = {'window': window} if window else {}
    with bpy.context.temp_override(**override):
        bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(
            filepath=path, export_format='GLB', use_active_scene=True,
            export_apply=True, export_yup=True, export_cameras=False, export_lights=False,
            export_draco_mesh_compression_enable=True, export_draco_mesh_compression_level=6,
            export_animations=True, export_animation_mode='SCENE', export_force_sampling=True,
            export_frame_range=True, export_anim_slide_to_zero=True, export_optimize_animation_size=True)


def main(out=None, blend=None):
    build()
    if out:
        export(os.path.abspath(out))
    if blend:
        bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=os.path.abspath(blend), copy=True)


def _cli():
    argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--') + 1:] if '--' in sys.argv else []
    pick = lambda flag: argv[argv.index(flag) + 1] if flag in argv else None  # noqa: E731
    return pick('--out'), pick('--blend')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(*_cli())
```

```python
"""Four narrow shop houses facing -Y, with awnings, lit windows, AC units and a roof spinner."""
import math
import random

import kit

GROUND = 0.14   # sidewalk top
FLOOR0 = 1.0    # shop floor height
FLOOR = 0.9     # upper floor height

SHOPS = [
    dict(name='Shop_A', x=-1.6, y=1.9, w=2.0, d=1.8, floors=2, body='#e8dcc4', trim='#7a4a2e', awning='#2f5d8a', roof='gable'),
    dict(name='Shop_B', x=0.6, y=1.9, w=2.2, d=1.8, floors=4, body='#8fb8ad', trim='#3d5a55', awning='#c8452f', roof='flat'),
    dict(name='Shop_C', x=2.8, y=1.9, w=2.0, d=1.8, floors=3, body='#c8634a', trim='#5b2f24', awning='#e7c24a', roof='parapet'),
    dict(name='Shop_D', x=2.9, y=-0.4, w=1.8, d=2.0, floors=2, body='#d9b98a', trim='#6a4b2c', awning='#3f7a5e', roof='gable'),
]


def top(name):
    shop = next(s for s in SHOPS if s['name'] == name)
    return GROUND + FLOOR0 + FLOOR * (shop['floors'] - 1)


def _shop(spec, index, root, rng):
    w, d, floors = spec['w'], spec['d'], spec['floors']
    height = FLOOR0 + FLOOR * (floors - 1)
    body, trim = kit.material(spec['name'] + '_body', spec['body'], 0.85), kit.material(spec['name'] + '_trim', spec['trim'], 0.7)
    glass, lit = kit.material('window_dark', '#2b3a44', 0.2), kit.material('window_lit', '#ffe2a8', 0.3, emission='#ffd08a', strength=2.0)
    shop = kit.empty(spec['name'], (spec['x'], spec['y'], GROUND), root)
    kit.box(spec['name'] + '_Body', (w, d, height), (0, 0, height / 2), body, shop)
    kit.boxes(spec['name'] + '_Bands', [((w + 0.06, d + 0.06, 0.06), (0, 0, FLOOR0 + FLOOR * f)) for f in range(floors - 1)] + [((w + 0.08, d + 0.08, 0.08), (0, 0, height))], trim, shop)
    front = -d / 2 - 0.02
    dark_windows, lit_windows = [], []
    for f in range(1, floors):
        z = FLOOR0 + FLOOR * (f - 1) + FLOOR * 0.5
        for x in (-w * 0.25, w * 0.25):
            (lit_windows if rng.random() < 0.4 else dark_windows).append(((0.5, 0.04, 0.42), (x, front, z)))
    if dark_windows:
        kit.boxes(spec['name'] + '_Windows', dark_windows, glass, shop)
    if lit_windows:
        kit.boxes(spec['name'] + '_Windows_Lit', lit_windows, lit, shop)
    kit.boxes(spec['name'] + '_Sills', [((0.6, 0.1, 0.05), (x, front - 0.03, z - 0.24)) for (_, (x, _, z)) in dark_windows + lit_windows], trim, shop)
    kit.box(spec['name'] + '_Shopfront', (w * 0.7, 0.04, 0.62), (0, front, 0.42), lit, shop)
    kit.box(spec['name'] + '_Awning', (w * 0.85, 0.5, 0.04), (0, front - 0.22, 0.98), kit.material(spec['name'] + '_awning', spec['awning'], 0.8), shop, rot=(math.radians(-18), 0, 0))
    kit.boxes(spec['name'] + '_Noren', [((0.18, 0.01, 0.32), (x, front - 0.04, 0.6)) for x in (-0.2, 0, 0.2)], kit.material('noren', '#24345a', 0.9, double_sided=True), shop)
    # roof
    tile = kit.material('roof_tile', '#7c3b32', 0.8)
    if spec['roof'] == 'gable':
        kit.prism(spec['name'] + '_Roof', w + 0.25, d + 0.25, 0.5, (0, 0, height + 0.04), tile, shop)
    elif spec['roof'] == 'flat':
        kit.boxes(spec['name'] + '_Parapet', [((w, 0.08, 0.2), (0, sy * (d / 2 - 0.04), height + 0.1)) for sy in (-1, 1)] + [((0.08, d, 0.2), (sx * (w / 2 - 0.04), 0, height + 0.1)) for sx in (-1, 1)], trim, shop)
    else:
        kit.boxes(spec['name'] + '_Parapet', [((w + 0.08, 0.1, 0.35), (0, -d / 2, height + 0.17)), ((w * 0.5, 0.1, 0.25), (0, -d / 2, height + 0.45))], trim, shop)
    # AC unit with spinning fan on the front, top floor
    unit = kit.material('ac_unit', '#d6d8d4', 0.6)
    fan_metal = kit.material('ac_fan', '#5d6166', 0.5, metallic=0.6)
    z = height - FLOOR * 0.5 if floors > 1 else 0.8
    kit.box(spec['name'] + '_AC', (0.45, 0.3, 0.35), (w / 2 - 0.3, front - 0.15, z), unit, shop, bevel=0.02)
    fan = kit.empty('AC_Fan_%d' % index, (w / 2 - 0.3, front - 0.31, z), shop)
    fan.rotation_mode = 'ZXY'
    fan.rotation_euler = (math.radians(90), 0, 0)
    kit.boxes('AC_Fan_%d_Blades' % index, [((0.22, 0.03, 0.05), (0, 0, 0), (0, math.radians(a), 0)) for a in (0, 60, 120)], fan_metal, fan)
    kit.spin(fan, 2, 6 + index)
    return shop


def build(root):
    rng = random.Random(7)
    for index, spec in enumerate(SHOPS, start=1):
        _shop(spec, index, root, rng)
    # Shop_C: balcony with laundry pole
    c = next(s for s in SHOPS if s['name'] == 'Shop_C')
    rail = kit.material('balcony_rail', '#3a3d40', 0.5, metallic=0.7)
    z = GROUND + FLOOR0 + FLOOR * 0.05
    kit.box('Shop_C_Balcony', (1.2, 0.4, 0.06), (c['x'], c['y'] - c['d'] / 2 - 0.2, z), rail, root)
    kit.boxes('Shop_C_Balcony_Rail', [((0.02, 0.02, 0.4), (c['x'] + x, c['y'] - c['d'] / 2 - 0.38, z + 0.2)) for x in (-0.58, -0.3, 0, 0.3, 0.58)] + [((1.2, 0.03, 0.03), (c['x'], c['y'] - c['d'] / 2 - 0.38, z + 0.4))], rail, root)
    kit.tube('Shop_C_Laundry_Pole', [(c['x'] - 0.6, c['y'] - c['d'] / 2 - 0.3, z + 0.75), (c['x'] + 0.6, c['y'] - c['d'] / 2 - 0.3, z + 0.75)], 0.012, rail)
    kit.boxes('Shop_C_Laundry', [((0.22, 0.01, 0.3), (c['x'] + x, c['y'] - c['d'] / 2 - 0.3, z + 0.58)) for x in (-0.35, 0, 0.3)], kit.material('laundry', '#f2efe6', 0.9, double_sided=True), root)
    # Shop_B: fire escape on the +X side
    b = next(s for s in SHOPS if s['name'] == 'Shop_B')
    steel = kit.material('fire_escape', '#4b4f54', 0.6, metallic=0.5)
    platforms = [((0.4, 1.2, 0.04), (b['x'] + b['w'] / 2 + 0.2, b['y'] - 0.1, GROUND + FLOOR0 + FLOOR * f)) for f in range(b['floors'] - 1)]
    kit.boxes('Shop_B_Fire_Escape', platforms, steel, root)
    # Shop_C roof spinner (turbine vent)
    vent = kit.material('vent', '#a7abb0', 0.4, metallic=0.8)
    spinner = kit.empty('Roof_Spinner', (c['x'] + 0.5, c['y'] + 0.3, top('Shop_C') + 0.1), root)
    kit.cylinder('Roof_Spinner_Drum', 0.12, 0.2, (0, 0, 0.1), vent, spinner)
    kit.boxes('Roof_Spinner_Fins', [((0.02, 0.26, 0.18), (0, 0, 0.1), (0, 0, math.radians(a))) for a in range(0, 180, 30)], vent, spinner)
    kit.spin(spinner, 2, 4)
```

"""Original hero prop: a round tanuki in a straw hat holding a swinging paper lantern, on a rooftop sign board."""
import math

import buildings
import kit


def build(root):
    shop = next(s for s in buildings.SHOPS if s['name'] == 'Shop_B')
    fur, belly = kit.material('tanuki_fur', '#9a6b45', 0.85), kit.material('tanuki_belly', '#f1dfc0', 0.85)
    mask, white = kit.material('tanuki_mask', '#3b2a22', 0.8), kit.material('tanuki_eye', '#ffffff', 0.4)
    hat, board = kit.material('tanuki_hat', '#d8b46a', 0.9), kit.material('sign_board', '#fff4dc', 0.7)
    outline, steel = kit.material('sign_outline', '#3a2a22', 0.7), kit.material('sign_steel', '#55595e', 0.5, metallic=0.7)
    paper = kit.material('lantern_paper', '#d8382f', 0.6, emission='#ff6a3d', strength=3.0)

    sign = kit.empty('Tanuki_Sign', (shop['x'], shop['y'] - 0.2, buildings.top('Shop_B')), root)
    kit.boxes('Tanuki_Sign_Legs', [((0.06, 0.06, 0.5), (x, 0.1, 0.25)) for x in (-0.6, 0.6)], steel, sign)
    kit.box('Tanuki_Sign_Outline', (1.8, 0.1, 1.5), (0, 0.12, 1.2), outline, sign, bevel=0.12)
    kit.box('Tanuki_Sign_Board', (1.66, 0.1, 1.36), (0, 0.06, 1.2), board, sign, bevel=0.1)
    kit.boxes('Tanuki_Sign_Glyphs', [(size, (x, 0.0, z + 0.62)) for size, (x, _, z) in kit.glyph_specs(1.2, 0.22, seed=11)],
              kit.material('sign_glyph_lit', '#ff8a3d', 0.4, emission='#ff7a2a', strength=2.5), sign)

    body = kit.empty('Tanuki_Body', (0, -0.08, 0.6), sign)
    kit.sphere('Tanuki_Torso', 0.32, (0, 0, 0.3), fur, body, scale=(1.15, 0.85, 1.2))
    kit.sphere('Tanuki_Belly', 0.24, (0, -0.16, 0.26), belly, body, scale=(1.0, 0.45, 1.1))
    kit.sphere('Tanuki_Head', 0.26, (0, -0.04, 0.82), fur, body)
    kit.boxes('Tanuki_Eye_Mask', [((0.16, 0.06, 0.1), (x, -0.25, 0.84)) for x in (-0.09, 0.09)], mask, body)
    kit.boxes('Tanuki_Eyes', [((0.05, 0.04, 0.05), (x, -0.29, 0.86)) for x in (-0.09, 0.09)], white, body)
    kit.sphere('Tanuki_Nose', 0.04, (0, -0.29, 0.77), mask, body)
    kit.boxes('Tanuki_Ears', [((0.1, 0.06, 0.12), (x, -0.02, 1.06), (0, 0, 0)) for x in (-0.16, 0.16)], mask, body)
    kit.cylinder('Tanuki_Hat', 0.34, 0.16, (0, -0.04, 1.08), hat, body, segments=20, radius_top=0.02)

"""Street clutter: utility pole and sagging power lines, banners, vending machine, post box, plants, bench, bicycle."""
import math

import buildings
import kit

G = buildings.GROUND


def _pole(root):
    wood, steel = kit.material('pole_wood', '#5a4636', 0.9), kit.material('pole_steel', '#7b7f84', 0.5, metallic=0.6)
    pole = kit.empty('Utility_Pole', (-2.45, -1.7, G), root)
    kit.cylinder('Utility_Pole_Shaft', 0.07, 4.6, (0, 0, 2.3), wood, pole, segments=10, radius_top=0.05)
    kit.boxes('Utility_Pole_Arms', [((1.4, 0.08, 0.08), (0, 0, 4.25)), ((1.0, 0.08, 0.08), (0, 0, 3.85))], wood, pole)
    kit.cylinder('Utility_Pole_Transformer', 0.16, 0.42, (0.22, 0.12, 3.35), steel, pole, segments=12)
    kit.boxes('Utility_Pole_Insulators', [((0.05, 0.05, 0.08), (x, 0, z + 0.08)) for x, z in ((-0.6, 4.25), (0, 4.25), (0.6, 4.25), (-0.45, 3.85), (0.45, 3.85))], kit.material('insulator', '#e9e4da', 0.4), pole)
    return pole


def _wires(root):
    black = kit.material('wire', '#1d1e20', 0.6, double_sided=True)
    px, py = -2.45, -1.7
    a, b = buildings.SHOPS[0], buildings.SHOPS[1]
    runs = [
        ((px - 0.6, py, G + 4.33), (a['x'] - 0.4, a['y'] - a['d'] / 2, buildings.top('Shop_A') - 0.1), 0.25),
        ((px, py, G + 4.33), (b['x'] - 0.6, b['y'] - b['d'] / 2, buildings.top('Shop_B') - 0.6), 0.3),
        ((px + 0.6, py, G + 4.33), (4.6, -2.2, G + 3.6), 0.35),          # runs off the slab, front right
        ((px - 0.45, py, G + 3.93), (-5.2, -0.4, G + 3.2), 0.3),         # runs off the slab, left
        ((px + 0.45, py, G + 3.93), (2.9 - 0.7, -1.4, G + 1.8), 0.2),    # to Shop_D
        ((px - 0.6, py, G + 4.33), (-4.8, -3.6, G + 3.4), 0.3),          # off the front-left corner
    ]
    for i, (start, end, drop) in enumerate(runs, start=1):
        kit.tube('Power_Line_%d' % i, kit.sag(start, end, drop), 0.012, black, root, sides=4)


def _banners(root):
    pole_mat = kit.material('banner_pole', '#2f3134', 0.5, metallic=0.5)
    colors = [('#2f7f7a', '#f4efe2'), ('#c8452f', '#fff3d6'), ('#f1e6c8', '#c8452f')]
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(((1.7, -0.95), (2.25, -1.55), (3.75, -1.55)), start=1):
        cloth, mark = colors[i - 1]
        kit.cylinder('Banner_%d_Pole' % i, 0.015, 1.7, (x, y, G + 0.85), pole_mat, root, segments=8)
        flag = kit.empty('Banner_%d' % i, (x, y, G + 1.62), root)
        kit.box('Banner_%d_Cloth' % i, (0.32, 0.01, 1.05), (0.17, 0, -0.55), kit.material('banner_%d' % i, cloth, 0.9, double_sided=True), flag)
        kit.boxes('Banner_%d_Marks' % i, [(size, (0.17 + x2, -0.008, -0.55 + z)) for size, (x2, _, z) in kit.glyph_specs(0.24, 0.8, seed=20 + i, cells=1, depth=0.004)], kit.material('banner_mark_%d' % i, mark, 0.9), flag)
        kit.swing(flag, 2, 9, 2, phase=0.27 * i)


def _street_furniture(root):
    red = kit.material('vending_red', '#d9473b', 0.5)
    vend = kit.empty('Vending_Machine', (-0.55, 0.78, G), root)
    kit.box('Vending_Machine_Body', (0.62, 0.46, 1.25), (0, 0, 0.625), red, vend, bevel=0.02)
    kit.box('Vending_Machine_Display', (0.48, 0.02, 0.56), (0, -0.235, 0.86), kit.material('vending_display', '#cfeeff', 0.2, emission='#bfe8ff', strength=2.2), vend)
    kit.boxes('Vending_Machine_Buttons', [((0.05, 0.02, 0.03), (-0.18 + 0.09 * k, -0.24, 0.5)) for k in range(5)], kit.material('vending_button', '#f4d35e', 0.4, emission='#f4d35e', strength=1.0), vend)

    post_red = kit.material('post_red', '#c62d2d', 0.45)
    post = kit.empty('Post_Box', (1.95, -0.85, G), root)
    kit.cylinder('Post_Box_Body', 0.17, 0.72, (0, 0, 0.36), post_red, post, segments=16)
    kit.sphere('Post_Box_Dome', 0.17, (0, 0, 0.72), post_red, post, scale=(1, 1, 0.55))
    kit.box('Post_Box_Slot', (0.16, 0.02, 0.03), (0, -0.17, 0.58), kit.material('post_slot', '#1f1f1f', 0.8), post)

    timber, iron = kit.material('bench_timber', '#a0703f', 0.8), kit.material('bench_iron', '#33363a', 0.5, metallic=0.6)
    bench = kit.empty('Bench', (-1.5, 0.72, G), root)
    kit.boxes('Bench_Slats', [((1.1, 0.12, 0.04), (0, y, 0.42)) for y in (-0.1, 0.04)] + [((1.1, 0.04, 0.12), (0, 0.12, 0.62))], timber, bench)
    kit.boxes('Bench_Legs', [((0.05, 0.3, 0.42), (x, 0, 0.21)) for x in (-0.48, 0.48)], iron, bench)

    frame = kit.material('bicycle_frame', '#2b6cb0', 0.4, metallic=0.4)
    bike = kit.empty('Bicycle', (1.15, 0.62, G), root)
    for name, cx in (('Bicycle_Wheel_Rear', -0.32), ('Bicycle_Wheel_Front', 0.32)):
        kit.tube(name, kit.ring((cx, 0, 0.24), 0.22, 'Y'), 0.015, iron, bike, sides=4)
    kit.tube('Bicycle_Frame', [(-0.32, 0, 0.24), (-0.05, 0, 0.5), (0.25, 0, 0.5), (0.32, 0, 0.24), (0.0, 0, 0.26), (-0.32, 0, 0.24)], 0.018, frame, bike, sides=5)
    kit.boxes('Bicycle_Seat_Bars', [((0.14, 0.05, 0.03), (-0.1, 0, 0.6)), ((0.03, 0.3, 0.03), (0.27, 0, 0.62))], iron, bike)
    bike.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.radians(8))


def _greenery(root):
    pot, leaf, leaf2 = kit.material('pot', '#b5653c', 0.85), kit.material('leaf', '#4f8a3c', 0.85), kit.material('leaf_light', '#6aa84f', 0.85)
    for i, (x, y, s) in enumerate(((-2.4, 0.9, 1.0), (-0.1, 0.82, 0.8), (3.6, -0.9, 1.1), (0.15, 0.82, 0.7), (2.35, 0.75, 0.9)), start=1):
        kit.cylinder('Plant_%d_Pot' % i, 0.13 * s, 0.24 * s, (x, y, G + 0.12 * s), pot, root, segments=10, radius_top=0.16 * s)
        kit.ico('Plant_%d_Leaves' % i, 0.2 * s, (x, y, G + 0.36 * s), leaf if i % 2 else leaf2, root, scale=(1, 1, 1.2))
    trunk = kit.material('trunk', '#6b4a33', 0.9)
    kit.tube('Tree_Trunk', [(3.4, -1.6, G), (3.45, -1.6, G + 0.9), (3.35, -1.55, G + 1.5)], 0.06, trunk, root, sides=6)
    for k, (dx, dy, dz, r) in enumerate(((0, 0, 1.6, 0.42), (0.25, 0.1, 1.4, 0.3), (-0.22, -0.05, 1.45, 0.32))):
        kit.ico('Tree_Canopy_%d' % (k + 1), r, (3.35 + dx, -1.55 + dy, G + dz), leaf2 if k else leaf, root)


def _signs_and_rails(root):
    blade = kit.empty('Shop_A_Blade_Sign', (-0.75, 1.0 - 0.02, G + 1.55), root)
    kit.box('Shop_A_Blade_Sign_Board', (0.06, 0.3, 0.8), (0, -0.18, 0), kit.material('blade_board', '#f6e7c8', 0.5, emission='#fff0cf', strength=1.4), blade)
    kit.boxes('Shop_A_Blade_Sign_Marks', [((0.02, s[0] * 0.5, s[2]), (-0.035, -0.18 + l[0] * 0.5, l[2])) for s, l in kit.glyph_specs(0.24, 0.62, seed=31, cells=1)], kit.material('blade_marks', '#7a1f1f', 0.6), blade)
    for spec, seed, lit in zip(buildings.SHOPS, (41, 42, 43, 44), (True, False, True, False)):
        y = spec['y'] - spec['d'] / 2 - 0.06
        holder = kit.empty(spec['name'] + '_Sign', (spec['x'], y, G + 1.2), root)
        face = kit.material('shop_sign_lit' if lit else 'shop_sign', '#fbf1d8' if lit else '#2f2a26', 0.5, emission='#ffe6b0' if lit else None, strength=1.6 if lit else 0.0)
        kit.box(spec['name'] + '_Sign_Board', (spec['w'] * 0.6, 0.05, 0.22), (0, 0, 0), face, holder)
        kit.boxes(spec['name'] + '_Sign_Marks', [(size, (x, -0.03, z)) for size, (x, _, z) in kit.glyph_specs(spec['w'] * 0.5, 0.18, seed=seed)], kit.material('shop_sign_marks_dark' if lit else 'shop_sign_marks_light', '#3a2a22' if lit else '#f1d9a0', 0.6), holder)
    red_rail = kit.material('red_rail', '#b23a30', 0.5)
    c = buildings.SHOPS[2]
    kit.boxes('Railing', [((0.05, 0.05, 0.5), (c['x'] - 0.9 + 0.3 * k, -1.62, G + 0.25)) for k in range(7)] + [((1.85, 0.04, 0.05), (c['x'] - 0.0, -1.62, G + z)) for z in (0.25, 0.48)], red_rail, root)
    crate = kit.material('crate', '#b08453', 0.85)
    kit.boxes('Crates', [((0.34, 0.3, 0.26), (3.75, -0.2, G + 0.13)), ((0.34, 0.3, 0.26), (3.75, 0.15, G + 0.13)), ((0.3, 0.28, 0.24), (3.73, -0.03, G + 0.38))], crate, root)


def build(root):
    _pole(root)
    _wires(root)
    _banners(root)
    _street_furniture(root)
    _greenery(root)
    _signs_and_rails(root)

### Task 5: Procedural studio environment

**Files:**
- Create: `examples/tokyo-studio.js`, `tests/tokyo-studio.test.js`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `studioCube(size = 64)` → `{size: number, faces: Float32Array[]}` matching `@margoengine/environment`'s `CubeFaces` (layers +X, −X, +Y, −Y, +Z, −Z; row 0 at the top; linear RGBA).

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {studioCube} from '../examples/tokyo-studio.js';

const mean = face => {let sum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < face.length; i += 4) sum += face[i]; return sum / (face.length / 4);};

test('six finite RGBA faces in CubeFaces layout', () => {
  const cube = studioCube();
  assert.equal(cube.size, 64);
  assert.equal(cube.faces.length, 6);
  for (const face of cube.faces) {
    assert.equal(face.length, 64 * 64 * 4);
    for (let i = 0; i < face.length; i++) assert.ok(Number.isFinite(face[i]) && face[i] >= 0);
    for (let i = 3; i < face.length; i += 4) assert.equal(face[i], 1);
  }
});

test('lit like a studio: bright ceiling softbox, darker floor', () => {
  const [, , ceiling, floor] = studioCube(32).faces;
  assert.ok(mean(ceiling) > mean(floor) * 3);

});

test('rejects sizes that are not a power of two', () => {
  assert.throws(() => studioCube(48), RangeError);
  assert.throws(() => studioCube(4), RangeError);
});

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

```js
/**
 * Procedural studio lighting cube for @margoengine/environment: Margo's stand-in for three.js RoomEnvironment.
 * Layers +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z (WebGPU order), row 0 at the top, linear RGBA.
 * @param {number} [size]
 * @returns {{size: number, faces: Float32Array[]}}
 */
export function studioCube(size = 64) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(Math.log2(size)) || size < 8) throw new RangeError('studioCube size must be a power of two >= 8');
  const faces = [];
  for (let face = 0; face < 6; face++) {
    const data = new Float32Array(size * size * 4);
    for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      const u = (x + 0.5) / size * 2 - 1, v = (y + 0.5) / size * 2 - 1, i = (y * size + x) * 4;
      let value = face === 2 ? 0.9 : face === 3 ? 0.18 : 0.45 - 0.25 * v; // walls brighten toward the ceiling
      if (face === 2 && Math.abs(u) < 0.45 && Math.abs(v) < 0.2) value = 6;   // ceiling softbox
      if (face === 0 && Math.abs(u) < 0.35 && v > -0.6 && v < 0.1) value = 3; // +X key panel
      if (face === 5 && Math.abs(u) < 0.5 && v > -0.5 && v < 0) value = 2;    // -Z fill panel
      data[i] = value; data[i + 1] = value * 0.98; data[i + 2] = value * 0.95; data[i + 3] = 1;
    }
    faces.push(data);
  }
  return {size, faces};
}
```

// Builds examples/tokyo-diorama.html with Vite and checks it in a real WebGPU browser.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {build} from 'vite';
import {openBrowser} from './browser.js';

const output = await build({configFile: false, logLevel: 'silent', build: {write: false, target: 'es2022', rollupOptions: {input: 'examples/tokyo-diorama.html'}}});
assert.ok(output.output.some(chunk => chunk.type === 'chunk' && chunk.isEntry), 'Tokyo diorama build failed');

const url = 'http://127.0.0.1:5193/examples/tokyo-diorama.html?quality=high';
const {page, close} = await openBrowser({startPath: '/examples/tokyo-diorama.html'});
const errors = [];
page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push(e.message));
page.on('console', m => {if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(m.text());});
try {
  await page.goto(url);
  await page.waitForSelector('#viewport[data-ready="true"]', {timeout: 60000});
  const result = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const {stage, model, animation, controls} = window.tokyoDemo;
    const tram = model.asset.doc.nodes.findIndex(n => n.name === 'Tram');
    const at = time => {animation.playing = false; animation.seek(time); stage.engine.render(); const m = model.nodes[tram].matrix; return [m[12], m[13], m[14]];};
    const a = at(0.5), b = at(3.5);
    return {tram, distance: Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]), clips: animation.clips.map(c => c.name), autoRotate: controls.autoRotate,
      stats: !!document.querySelector('[data-margo-stats]'), status: document.querySelector('#status').textContent};
  });
  assert.ok(result.tram >= 0, 'Tram node missing');
  assert.deepEqual(result.clips, ['Diorama']);
  assert.ok(result.distance > 1, 'Tram did not move along its track: ' + JSON.stringify(result));
  assert.ok(result.autoRotate, 'Auto-rotate should be on without reduced motion');
  assert.ok(result.stats, 'Stats panel missing');
  assert.equal(result.status, 'Ready');
  await page.screenshot({path: 'test-results/tokyo-diorama.png'});

  // Reduced motion: paused clip, no auto-rotate.
  await page.emulateMedia({reducedMotion: 'reduce'});
  await page.goto(url);
  await page.waitForSelector('#viewport[data-ready="true"]', {timeout: 60000});
  assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(() => [window.tokyoDemo.animation.playing, window.tokyoDemo.controls.autoRotate]), [false, false]);
  await page.emulateMedia({reducedMotion: 'no-preference'});

  // Phone viewport: scene stays visible above the controls.
  await page.setViewportSize({width: 390, height: 844});
  await page.goto(url);
  await page.waitForSelector('#viewport[data-ready="true"]', {timeout: 60000});
  const layout = await page.evaluate(() => {const r = document.querySelector('#viewport').getBoundingClientRect(); return {height: r.height, overflowX: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth};});
  assert.ok(layout.height >= 300 && !layout.overflowX, 'Phone layout hides the diorama: ' + JSON.stringify(layout));
  await page.screenshot({path: 'test-results/tokyo-diorama-phone.png'});
  await page.setViewportSize({width: 1440, height: 1100});

  // Missing asset: visible error, no blank page.
  await page.route('**/assets/tokyo-diorama.glb', route => route.fulfill({status: 404, body: 'missing'}));
  errors.length = 0;
  await page.goto(url);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('#status').textContent === 'Unable to load scene');
  assert.ok((await page.textContent('#error')).length > 0, 'Load failure not reported');
  await page.unroute('**/assets/tokyo-diorama.glb');
  errors.length = 0; // the 404 itself logs a console error
} finally {
  await close();
}
assert.deepEqual(errors, [], 'Console errors: ' + errors.join('\n'));
console.log('Tokyo diorama browser check passed');

```ts
import {createStage} from 'margoengine';
import {loadGLTF} from '@margoengine/gltf-pro';
import {DracoDecoder} from '@margoengine/decoders';
import {Animation} from '@margoengine/animation';
import {OrbitControls} from '@margoengine/controls';
import {ColorBackground, Environment, EnvironmentLighting} from '@margoengine/environment';
import {Stats} from '@margoengine/stats';
import {applyQualityTier, paceEngine, watchQuality} from '@margoengine/quality';
import {engineRuntime} from '@margoengine/core/extension';
import {submitPrincipalScene} from '../packages/shared/demo-frame.js';
import {studioCube} from './tokyo-studio.js';
applyQualityTier();

const status = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#status')!, error = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#error')!;
const abort = new AbortController();
let dispose: (() => void) | undefined;
addEventListener('pagehide', () => {abort.abort(); dispose?.();}, {once: true});

try {
  const stage = await createStage('#viewport', {backend: 'webgpu', autoStart: false, controls: false, capacity: 4096,
    label: 'Animated Tokyo street corner diorama', camera: {position: [-6, 5, 8], target: [0, 1, 0], near: 0.05, far: 200},
    onError: reason => {error.textContent = String(reason);}});
  dispose = () => stage.dispose();
  if (abort.signal.aborted) {stage.dispose(); abort.signal.throwIfAborted();}
  paceEngine(stage.engine);
  ColorBackground.attach(stage.engine, {color: '#bfe3dd'});

  const draco = new DracoDecoder({workerLimit: 2});
  let model;
  try {
    model = await loadGLTF(stage.engine, new URL('./assets/tokyo-diorama.glb', import.meta.url), {signal: abort.signal, decoders: {draco}});
  } finally {
    draco.dispose();
  }

  const environment = await Environment.attach(stage.engine, studioCube(64));
  EnvironmentLighting.attach(stage.engine, environment).add(model);
  const runtime = engineRuntime(stage.engine);
  runtime.lighting.direction.set([-3, 8, 5, 4]);
  runtime.lighting.radiance.set([1, 0.95, 0.88, 0.25]);
  Stats.attach(stage.engine);

  const controls = OrbitControls.attach(stage.engine);
  controls.enableDamping = true;
  controls.enablePan = false;
  controls.autoRotateSpeed = 0.6;
  stage.canvas.tabIndex = 0;
  stage.canvas.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (!['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', '+', '-'].includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    if (event.key === '+' || event.key === '-') stage.canvas.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', {deltaY: event.key === '+' ? -100 : 100, cancelable: true}));
    else {controls.rotateLeft(event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? 0.1 : event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? -0.1 : 0); controls.rotateUp(event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? 0.1 : event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? -0.1 : 0);}
  });
  const b = model.bounds;
  stage.engine.camera.fitToBoundingBox([b[0], b[1], b[2]], [b[3], b[4], b[5]], {aspect: stage.canvas.clientWidth / stage.canvas.clientHeight, duration: 0});
  controls.saveState();

  const animation = Animation.attach(model);
  animation.play('Diorama');
  const pause = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#pause')!, rotate = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('#auto-rotate')!;
  const speed = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('#speed')!, speedValue = document.querySelector<HTMLOutputElement>('#speed-value')!;
  const reset = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#reset-view')!;
  const sync = () => {
    pause.textContent = animation.playing ? 'Pause animation' : 'Resume animation';
    pause.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!animation.playing));
    rotate.checked = controls.autoRotate;
  };
  const reduced = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  const motion = () => {animation.playing = !reduced.matches; controls.autoRotate = !reduced.matches; sync();};
  motion();
  reduced.addEventListener('change', motion);
  stage.use({name: 'tokyo-motion', setup() {}, dispose: () => reduced.removeEventListener('change', motion)});
  pause.addEventListener('click', () => {animation.playing = !animation.playing; sync();});
  rotate.addEventListener('change', () => {controls.autoRotate = rotate.checked;});
  speed.addEventListener('input', () => {animation.options.speed = speed.valueAsNumber; speedValue.value = speed.value + '×';});
  reset.addEventListener('click', () => controls.reset());
  for (const control of [pause, rotate, speed, reset]) control.disabled = false;

  Object.assign(window, {tokyoDemo: {stage, model, animation, controls}});
  await submitPrincipalScene(() => stage.engine.render(), runtime.gpu!.queue, {signal: abort.signal});
  stage.engine.start();
  watchQuality();
  document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#viewport')!.dataset.ready = 'true';
  status.textContent = 'Ready';
} catch (reason) {
  dispose?.();
  if (!abort.signal.aborted) {status.textContent = 'Unable to load scene'; error.textContent = String(reason);}
}
```

Expected: `Tokyo diorama browser check passed`; screenshots in `test-results/tokyo-diorama.png` and `test-results/tokyo-diorama-phone.png`. Open the desktop screenshot and compare against the spec: pale mint background, three-quarter view, lit signs and lantern visible.

Expected: all PASS.
